title: Task-metric bridge for hybrid FP8/INT8 quant validation
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a lightweight, extensible 'metric bridge' service and scorer library that normalizes and aggregates task-specific quality metrics for hybrid quantization validation (FP8 and INT8 profiles). Deliverables: (1) modular scorer interfaces for language-model intrinsic metrics (perplexity), knowledge benchmarks (MMLU-style split + macro-averaging), and generation metrics (ROUGE/BLEU, chrF), (2) calibration-aware normalization transforms so scores are comparable across precision modes and sequence lengths, (3) an aggregation/thresholding layer to produce pass/fail gating decisions for CI and release automation, and (4) a small dashboard prototype with examples. Goal is to provide consistent, debuggable signals to tie quant profiles to release gating and rollback rules.
acceptance_criteria: Library exposes scorer plugin interface and three reference scorers: perplexity-batcher, mmlu-split-aggregator, and rouge-bleu-generator-scorer
Normalization transforms implemented: length-aware perplexity adjustment, calibration-offset estimate between FP8/INT8 and baseline FP16, and task-weighted aggregation config
End-to-end validation runs for 3 representative models showing measured metric deltas for FP16->FP8 and FP16->INT8 across SQuAD-like QA, an open summarization set, and MMLU subset
JSON pass/fail report format defined and produced by CI job (schema stable) and threshold config stored in runtime-1.22 release branch
PR with code, tests, and a small Confluence runbook merged and a demo in weekly quant sync
comments: 2026-03-05 - Maya Patel: Kickoff & spike. Implemented prototype perplexity pipeline using existing eval harness. Observed length bias for short prompts when using int8 kernels; need length-aware normalization.

2026-03-07 - Jun Park: Pulled data for MMLU 5-shot splits. Initial macro-averaging differs between FP8 and INT8 by ~1.8% on the small 10-topic sample (model: redwood-open-1.0). Added bootstrapped CI to estimate variance.

2026-03-09 - PR Draft: github.com/redwood-inference/quant-metrics/pull/112 - Adds scorer interface and perplexity-batcher. Needs review for threading and batching semantics. Performance tests pending.

2026-03-10 - Design note: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/QUANT/metric-bridge - Describes normalization math (log-perplexity offsets and sequence-length regression). Link included in PR description.

2026-03-11 - Engineering sync: Decision to implement calibration-offset estimate per-task using a small validation fold rather than a single global offset. Trade-off: slightly more runtime for improved false-positive gating.

2026-03-12 - QA: Ran rouge/bleu evals on summarization set (n=500) for fp16/fp8/int8; rouge-l drops 0.9 for fp8, 1.6 for int8 vs fp16 in this sample. Adding task weights to the final aggregate so summarization has higher tolerance to small ROUGE regressions.

2026-03-13 - Jun Park: Merged unit tests and CI job skeleton. Next: dashboard prototype and hook into canary-rollout pipeline for automated gating. Filing follow-up tasks for extended MMLU sweep and adversarial prompts.
notes: - Use micro-batching in scorer to amortize tokenization and LM scoring overhead across examples; keep deterministic seeding for bootstrap CI.
- Calibration strategy: per-task affine offset applied to log-prob space estimated from a 1k example fold; store offsets per model+profile in calibration store.
- Aggregation: configurable weights per task, with option for conservative gating (max-delta rule) or averaged score rule.
